launch_slurm_job: launch a Slurm job by submitting an sbatch script with GPU nodes and conda environment
copy_python_dir: copy Python files from one directory to another using rsync with selective inclusion
retrieve_partition_max_time: retrieve the maximum time limits for each Slurm partition using sinfo
